topic: Why Itachi never cast Tsukuyomi on Naruto: the eye-contact rule, the Contact fight under Kabuto's control, and the cost argument
title: Why Itachi Never Used Tsukuyomi On Naruto
description:
Itachi had one of the most feared genjutsu in Naruto, and across the fights we see he never cast it on Naruto. This theory walks through the eye-contact rule, the Jiraiya fight where he backed off, and the Contact episode where Kabuto was steering him. Was the restraint about cost, mercy, or strategy? I lean toward a mix of all three.
